goal: Test whether a trained JANUS predictor can correctly precommit future byte values, while retaining every full byte and bit and comparing to cryptographic-randomness baselines.

protocol.receiver: JanusTinyTransformer prediction fixed in Git branch before future OS RNG generation
protocol.sender: Independent GitHub hosted OS secrets.token_bytes(32) at least 120 seconds after precommit
protocol.primary_test: unconditional exact 8-bit full byte matches among all 32 forecast bytes per trial
protocol.secondary_test: unconditional 256-bit accuracy, p-values and Brier loss
protocol.use_for_self_learning: Only complete, verified past early/future/comparison triplets, chronological 12-trial epochs, disjoint 4-trial holdout, fail-closed improvement gate

one_observed_full_byte.note: Identical historical and later byte is not a selectable future message transmitted backwards.

cumulative_statistics.caveat: The 160 trials are 32 bytes each from five sealed completed Retro Lab runs. Deutsch-v2 one-shot comparison remains separately archived and is not combined as the same trained predictor.

self_learning.independent_validation: Disjoint chronological 4-complete-trial holdout, fit on 8 previous trials; no fit on current unknown random target
self_learning.future_ideal_evidence: Newly frozen future targets must be guessed above chance on independent prospective holdout at preregistered error controls; never select just matched bytes
self_learning.reason_for_hold: No verified prospective predictive improvement and no physical backward-time channel.

deployed_bounded_campaign.schedule_utc: 13 minutes after 01:00, 07:00, 13:00 and 19:00, daily; hosted GitHub scheduling may delay
deployed_bounded_campaign.dates: 2026-11-06 through 2026-11-20 inclusive; scheduled trials skipped after UTC 2026-11-20
deployed_bounded_campaign.job_concurrency: 1 campaign at a time; never cancel unfinished A/B trial
deployed_bounded_campaign.previous_regression_failure_reason: Floating rounding gave 0.9999999999999999 instead of exact p=1 for 0 full-byte matches; numerical special case fixed and retested successfully.

conclusion.engineering: PASS: five real sealed early/later trials audited, exact full-byte accounting added, prospective bounded multi-daily schedule installed, three tests green.
conclusion.scientific: NO: A single full-byte match in 160 attempts has p~0.465 for at-least-one chance success, and cannot be used as controllable retrocausal message.
conclusion.next_action: After at least 12 previous completed A/B trials, evaluate only prior history with the existing fail-closed chronologically disjoint calibration gate; continue preserving all outcomes until the bounded campaign ends.
